decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.0%, S&P 500 +0.2%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Despite three open slots and $889 in cash, several candidates (CRDO, PBF, SNAP) show strong multi-signal setups, but past lessons say not to force buys on neutral days — better to hold cash and wait for a genuine risk-on move (NASDAQ +2%+) to deploy it with conviction. All 7 existing positions are held unchanged; stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle exits automatically if triggered.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially flat today, with the S&P 500 inching up 0.2% and the Nasdaq unchanged, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to major catalysts. Without a strong directional push in either large-cap tech or the broader market, there's little evidence of fresh institutional buying or selling pressure. This kind of quiet, low-volatility session is common between major earnings or macro data releases.
market_education.summary_zh: 大市今日表現大致持平,標普500指數微升0.2%,納斯達克指數則維持不變,反映投資者目前處於觀望狀態,未見明顯的方向性走勢。由於大型科技股及整體市場均缺乏強勁的買賣動力,顯示機構資金暫未有明顯進出。這種低波動的平靜交易日,通常出現在重大業績或宏觀數據公佈之間的空檔期。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Patience in trading means resisting the urge to act just because you have cash available or open slots to fill. Even when candidates look attractive on paper, waiting for a clearer market signal — like a strong risk-on day — often leads to better entry points and avoids chasing weak momentum.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 交易中的「耐性」是指不要因為手頭有現金或有空置倉位,就勉強進行買賣。即使某些候選股票在數據上看起來不錯,耐心等待更明確的市場信號(例如強烈的風險偏好日)往往能帶來更好的入市時機,並避免追逐疲弱的升勢。
